axioms.name: Experimental.P03_09.hurwitz_pole_integral_rational_remainder
axioms.meaning: For every k>0, rational 0<theta<=1 and j>=0, the actual density divided by y^2+(j+theta)^2 is integrable and its integral differs from the actual shifted Hurwitz tail times (j+theta)^(2k) by a rational number.
dependencies: Shifted Hurwitz Dirichlet series and finite initial sum

axioms.name: Experimental.P03_09.character_power_series_blocks
axioms.meaning: For each of the five explicit primitive-real-character coefficient tables and every 0<z<1, the power series HasSum equals its displayed factored numerator divided by 1-z^q.
dependencies: Explicit periodic coefficient tables for conductors 3,4,5,8

typed_interface_coverage: See Target.md and Assumptions.json; not all paper objects/interfaces are necessarily encoded.
